_comment: Editorial content for MDTL. Every fact here is attributable — see sourceNote. No image is attached. The company publishes no website of its own, so website, head office, phone and CEO are left empty.
description: Media Times Limited is a Pakistani media company operating in print, electronic and digital media. Its business units are the Daily Times English-language newspaper, the Sunday Times magazine distributed with it, the Urdu daily Aaj Kal, Business Plus TV and Zaiqa TFC, together with the digital and social-media operations of those titles.
sourceNote: The company's own corporate briefing presentation filed with the Pakistan Stock Exchange (dps.psx.com.pk, corporate briefing November 2025), read 2026-10-17.
